subject.title: fix(ui): keep agent selection aligned across session switches

question: Should the project require a compatibility path for clients connected to older Gateways that do not send `SessionObserverDigest.agentId`, or accept that those global observer digests are suppressed until the Gateway is upgraded?
rationale: The new optional protocol field is deliberately used as an ownership requirement for global observer projection, which can change visible behavior for mixed-version client/Gateway deployments; repository policy treats protocol and compatibility changes as maintainer-visible decisions.

options.title: Require mixed-version proof
options.body: Demonstrate or implement a bounded compatibility behavior for an updated client receiving legacy global observer digests from an older Gateway.

options.title: Accept coordinated upgrade
options.body: Document and accept that global observer status is suppressed for legacy Gateway payloads until the paired Gateway is upgraded.

recommendation.title: Require mixed-version proof
recommendation.body: Demonstrate or implement a bounded compatibility behavior for an updated client receiving legacy global observer digests from an older Gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch centralizes the affected ownership contract across the Gateway and all client implementations.
